english.title: Use a wheeled vehicle on a road when the fuel tank was not constructed / maintained to prevent leakage
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a wheeled vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), when its fuel tank was not so constructed and maintained that leakage of any liquid or vapour from it was adequately prevented
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 39(2) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 39(1) partly defines 'fuel tank'
(ii) See regulation 39 for exceptions
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H203 and H205.
(v) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant used **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). The fuel tank on the vehicle was not

(A)_[fitted with a cap]_
(B)_[constructed or maintained]_

so as to avoid the leakage of fuel or vapour from it.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
